item.title: Which eco-friendly laundry detergents actually clean your clothes? I put 11 to the test
item.summary: Our writer spent weeks putting capsules, sheets and liquid detergent through their paces to find the best for your clothes and the planet • Sustainable cleaning subscriptions that make life easier Nothing makes falling into bed more enjoyable than freshly laundered sheets, especially if they’ve just been dried in the sunshine. It’s a definite bonus, though, to know your clean bedding won’t bring you out in a rash or pollute your local river. Laundry detergent can be a troublesome product. A few years ago, I suffered a full-body rash after using pound-shop detergent on my sheets. I switched to a big-brand product and never had a reaction again, but there’s still the question of whether its ingredients may be causing environmental harm after they’ve gone down the drain.
